latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of habit-tracker.

- Track daily and weekly habits with streak counts and progress visualization.
- Log habit completions via conversation.
- Set reminders for specific habits.
- Flexible support for daily, weekly, or custom cadence habits.
- Options to pause, archive, or review habit statistics.
- All data stored locally for privacy.
